market_outlook.short_term: Highly volatile. CPI data (imminent) is the binary catalyst—hot print triggers 50-75bp hike repricing, equity selloff, yield spike to 5.2%+. Oil above $100 sustains inflation pressure. Bessent's failed yen intervention adds FX volatility. Expect 5-8% equity drawdown risk if CPI exceeds 3.5% YoY. Gold and energy outperform.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious. Three Fed hikes likely push policy rate to restrictive territory, pressuring rate-sensitive sectors (REITs, tech, housing). Oil normalization depends on Iran de-escalation. AI capex cycle continues but OpenAI pause introduces 1-2 quarter digestion. Consumer spending bifurcation persists. European direct lending (ICG €15B) and banking consolidation create structural opportunities. Critical minerals decoupling from China is multi-year theme.
